title: Expose first-demo Plant State trust and Advisor missing-data behavior in UI/API
verify: Plant card/history or advisor surface exposes confirmed/probable/unknown/conflict labels or equivalent bounded projection.
Missing/stale pH/EC produces a visible clarify or measurement prompt.
Action-implying output appears only as Safety Gate route/block/pending path, not immediate instruction.
Run the frontend/UI smoke or e2e gate once the frontend test runner exists; until then, record API/UI handoff evidence and the missing-runner reason in /verify.
evidence_required: VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
UI/e2e evidence when a frontend test runner exists; if no frontend runner exists yet, /verify must record the no-run reason and API/UI handoff evidence under the task report.
constraints: UI Feed projection is presentation-only and never agent working context.
User-visible wording before Safety Gate clearance and approval must not imply immediate physical action.
API responses expose bounded refs and redacted summaries only.
invariants: UI Feed content cannot become future agent context.
Secrets/auth material cannot enter screenshots, UI Feed, Bus, traces, exports, or context.
verification_targets: UI/e2e smoke evidence or explicit no-runner handoff note
